verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for an observability SDK and CLI like Bento, but the evidence never documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out for the product itself. The note about skipping 'the analytics layer' when wiring into an existing OpenTelemetry pipeline is a trace-routing choice, not an opt-out of vendor telemetry, so it is adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
